changes_made.explanation: Minor normalization of model names and output descriptions for consistency
Normalized metric names to base forms and removed redundant variants. Added Open LLM Leaderboard metrics mentioned in the paper.

The paper does NOT use LLMs as judges after generation. GPT-4 is used as an optimizer LLM within the Auto Evol-Instruct framework to analyze evolution trajectories and optimize evolving methods, but not to evaluate final generated outputs. All evaluation is done through automatic metrics on benchmarks.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using benchmark metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automated instruction evolution using LLMs, with evaluation conducted through standard benchmarks. The key contribution is the Auto Evol-Instruct framework that automates the design of evolving methods. While LLMs are used extensively within the framework (as evol LLM and optimizer LLM), they are not used as judges to evaluate final outputs - all evaluation is through automatic metrics on established benchmarks.
